mapper.insert: insert into academic_agent_artifact ( artifact_id, session_id, user_id, run_id, tool_invocation_id, source_type, source_name, artifact_type, title, content, download_url, create_time ) values ( #{artifactId}, #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{runId}, #{toolInvocationId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceName}, #{artifactType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{downloadUrl}, #{createTime} ) on duplicate key update run_id = values(run_id), tool_invocation_id = values(tool_invocation_id), source_type = values(source_type), source_name = values(source_name), title = values(title), content = values(content), download_url = values(download_url)

insert into academic_agent_run ( run_id, session_id, project_id, request_id, user_id, task_type, question, status, model_name, final_summary, error_code, error_message, started_at, finished_at, duration_millis, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{runId}, #{sessionId}, #{projectId}, #{requestId}, #{userId}, #{taskType}, #{question}, #{status}, #{modelName}, #{finalSummary}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{durationMillis}, now(), now() ) on duplicate key update run_id = values(run_id)
mapper.update: update academic_agent_run set status = #{status}, model_name = #{modelName}, final_summary = #{finalSummary}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, duration_millis = #{durationMillis}, update_time = now() where run_id = #{runId}

update academic_llm_invocation set response_text = #{responseText}, status = #{status}, prompt_tokens = #{promptTokens}, completion_tokens = #{completionTokens}, total_tokens = #{totalTokens}, fallback_used = #{fallbackUsed}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, latency_millis = #{latencyMillis} where invocation_id = #{invocationId}

update academic_tool_invocation set result_summary = #{resultSummary}, result_json = #{resultJson}, status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, latency_millis = #{latencyMillis} where invocation_id = #{invocationId}
mapper.select: select run_id, session_id, project_id, request_id, user_id, task_type, question, status, model_name, final_summary, error_code, error_message, started_at, finished_at, duration_millis, create_time, update_time from academic_agent_run where user_id = #{userId} and run_id = #{runId} limit 1

select run_id, session_id, project_id, request_id, user_id, task_type, question, status, model_name, final_summary, error_code, error_message, started_at, finished_at, duration_millis, create_time, update_time from academic_agent_run where user_id = #{userId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1

select run_id, session_id, project_id, request_id, user_id, task_type, question, status, model_name, final_summary, error_code, error_message, started_at, finished_at, duration_millis, create_time, update_time from academic_agent_run where user_id = #{userId} and session_id = #{sessionId} order by started_at desc, id desc limit 1

select invocation_id, run_id, request_id, session_id, user_id, model_name, prompt_summary, response_text, status, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, fallback_used, error_message, started_at, finished_at, latency_millis from academic_llm_invocation where run_id = #{runId} order by started_at asc, id asc

select invocation_id, run_id, request_id, session_id, user_id, tool_call_id, tool_name, action, arguments_json, result_summary, result_json, status, retry_count, error_message, started_at, finished_at, latency_millis from academic_tool_invocation where run_id = #{runId} order by started_at asc, id asc

select artifact_id, session_id, user_id, run_id, tool_invocation_id, source_type, source_name, artifact_type, title, content, download_url, create_time from academic_agent_artifact where run_id = #{runId} order by create_time asc, id asc
